profiles.reference: Windows 11 office PC, 6-12 cores, 16 GB RAM, NVMe SSD

profiles.label: 超前
profiles.reference: Recent high-end Windows 11 PC, 16+ cores, 32 GB+ RAM, fast NVMe SSD

limitations: Legacy Windows 10 and old SATA-SSD PCs are excluded from the active release gate and are retained only as historical engineering evidence.
CPU scheduling pressure is enforced with a Windows Job Object hard cap normalized to one logical processor and a fixed affinity mask.
RAM tiers are evaluated as per-process private-byte budgets; the harness does not remove physical RAM from Windows.
The harness does not emulate another CPU microarchitecture, cache hierarchy, storage latency, GPU, firmware or background software mix.
E3 static-versus-learned relative cost is measured on the native host with interleaved samples because Job Object quota waits cannot be attributed fairly to one half of a paired microbenchmark.
Results are engineering projections and must later be confirmed on representative physical PCs before public release.
